title: echinodorus palifolius var. latifolius
intro: Echinodorus palifolius var. latifolius, commonly known as Broad-leaved Anacharis, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the family Alismataceae. It is native to tropical and subtropical regions and is often used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. Bioactive constituents of Broad-leaved Anacharis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
